offerings.name: Reader API https://s.jina.ai
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Prototype Development: $50, 1 Billion Tokens, 0.050 / 1M tokens; Production Deployment: $500, 11 Billion Tokens, 0.045 / 1M tokens.
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens. Toy Experiment: 10 Million Tokens, Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC), Free.
offerings.output_type: 搜索网络并返回前五个结果的 URL 和内容；每项为干净、LLM-friendly text。JSON 模式返回五条条目，每条包含 URL、title、content、timestamp（如可用）。
offerings.note: 每次请求固定消耗 token，starting from 10000 tokens；免费/API Key 100 RPM，付费 1000 RPM。
